name: stoa-js
description: StoaChain TypeScript stack — workspace root for @stoachain/kadena-stoic-legacy (vendored @kadena/*) and @stoachain/stoa-core (chain-generic foundation). The Ouronet-level halves (@ouronet/ouronet-core, @ouronet/ouronet-codex) were split out to OuroborosNetwork/ouronet-libs in the Phase-4 reorg and consume these from npm.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@stoachain/kadena-stoic-legacy && npm run build --workspace=@stoachain/stoa-core
